hook: In nineteen thirty-two, Australia sent soldiers with machine guns to fight an enemy.
cta: Follow for more history that sounds made up.

captions.hook_line: In 1932, Australia sent machine guns to fight 20,000 emus. The emus won 🪶
captions.body: Major G.P.W. Meredith's unit fired close to 10,000 rounds in Western Australia's wheat belt. The birds scattered, a gun jammed at a dam ambush, and the army withdrew.
captions.share_line: Send this to someone who needs a history fact that sounds fake.

visual_style: Stylized 3D animated film look, Pixar-quality expressive characters who act out each line, bold saturated colors, bold readable shapes, strong rim light, clean simple backgrounds

blocks.narration: In nineteen thirty-two, Australia sent soldiers with machine guns to fight an enemy that was destroying its wheat farms: twenty thousand emus.
blocks.visual: Three cartoon 1930s Australian soldiers in slouch hats riding an old army truck down a dusty red outback road, an old machine gun mounted in the back

shots.visual: Three cartoon 1930s Australian soldiers in slouch hats riding an old army truck down a dusty red outback road, an old machine gun mounted in the back
shots.action: The truck bounces down the road kicking up red dust; the soldiers grip their hats with determined faces; the camera tracks alongside

shots.visual: A huge flock of cartoon emus with big expressive eyes in a golden wheat field under a blue sky
shots.action: The emus stampede through the wheat toward the camera, stalks flying everywhere

blocks.narration: The emus scattered every time the guns came out. At one ambush at a dam, a gun jammed, and the flock simply ran away.
blocks.visual: The same cartoon soldiers crouched behind an old machine gun at the edge of a wheat field, a crowd of emus in front of them

shots.visual: The same cartoon soldiers crouched behind an old machine gun at the edge of a wheat field, a crowd of emus in front of them
shots.action: As the soldier swings the gun around, the emus burst apart in every direction like bowling pins

shots.visual: Close-up of one of the same cartoon soldiers beside a small outback water dam, yanking at the handle of an old machine gun
shots.action: He tugs the handle, the gun coughs a puff of smoke and jams; his face falls

shots.visual: The same cartoon emus sprinting away over a red-dirt hill at full speed
shots.action: The emus sprint and leap over the hill; the last one glances back at the camera with a cheeky look

blocks.narration: After about ten thousand rounds, the army pulled out, and the emus stayed. Follow for more history that sounds made up.
blocks.visual: The same cartoon soldiers loading empty ammunition boxes onto their truck at sunset, looking defeated

shots.visual: The same cartoon soldiers loading empty ammunition boxes onto their truck at sunset, looking defeated
shots.action: They slump, toss the last box into the truck and drive off in a cloud of dust

shots.visual: A proud cartoon emu standing on a golden wheat sheaf at sunset, the rest of the flock behind it
shots.action: The emu puffs out its chest, turns to the camera and winks while the flock bobs behind it
